step1_figure.circuit_type: Common-Source Amplifier with Diode-Connected PMOS Load (and Bias Network)
step1_figure.description: Common-source amplifier (M1) with a diode-connected PMOS load (M2) biased through a high-value resistor and DC decoupling capacitor from a self-biased reference generator (SUB_1 / Fig. 20.43), driven by a voltage source with 100k source resistance.

low_frequency_gain.description: Low-frequency small-signal AC voltage gain (Av = vout/vin or vout/vs)

equation.explanation: Ratio of transconductance of input driver M1 to diode-connected load M2 transconductance, assuming 1/gm2 << ro1||ro2.
equation.assumptions: ro1, ro2 >> 1/gm2, Rs effect negligible at very low frequency through large coupling capacitor.

sky130_expected.calculation: For matched biasing with equal gm1 = gm2 = 150 uA/V: Av = -1 V/V = 0 dB. With channel-length modulation ro included (ro ~ 1/(lambda*Id) = 1/(0.1*20u) = 500k), Av = -(1/gm2 || ro1 || ro2) / (1/gm1) = -(6.67k || 250k) * 150u = -0.974 V/V = -0.23 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode-connected PMOS load provides an impedance of approximately 1/gm2, yielding a nominal voltage gain close to -1 (0 dB) with slight reduction from finite drain output resistance.

input_pole_frequency.description: 3-dB pole frequency associated with the amplifier input RC network

equation.explanation: Pole formed by source resistance Rs (100k) and total input capacitance including gate-source capacitance Cgs1 and Miller-multiplied gate-drain capacitance CMI = Cgd1*(1 + gm1/gm2).
equation.assumptions: Low-frequency gain Av = -1 used in Miller approximation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by 100k source impedance and the effective input capacitance (Cgs + 2*Cgd).

output_pole_frequency.description: Pole frequency associated with the amplifier output node

equation.explanation: Output pole formed by the resistance seen at output (approximately 1/gm2) and total capacitance Cout = Csg2 + CMO, where CMO = Cgd1*(1 + gm2/gm1).
equation.assumptions: Output resistance dominated by diode-connected PMOS 1/gm2.

sky130_expected.calculation: With gm2 ~ 150 uA/V (Rout ~ 6.5k), Csg2 ~ 70 fF, CMO = 4.0 fF: Cout = 74 fF; fout = 1 / (2 * pi * 6.5e3 * 74e-15) = 331 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode-connected load presents low impedance (~6.5 kohm), placing output pole well into VHF/UHF band.

rhp_zero_frequency.description: Right-half plane (RHP) transmission zero frequency created by feedforward through Cgd1

equation.explanation: Feedforward current through Cgd1 equals transconductance current gm1*vin at fz, producing a numerator zero in the right-half s-plane.
equation.assumptions: Unilateral feedback assumption broken at extremely high frequencies.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by intrinsic transit time and overlap/fringing gate-drain capacitance.

equation.explanation: Magnitude evaluated beyond both input (58 MHz) and output (331 MHz) poles.
equation.assumptions: Two-pole approximation valid below RHP zero frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Text gives -20 dB (0.1 V/V) at 400 MHz due to 20 dB/dec roll-off from fin and additional roll-off from fout.

phase_at_400mhz.description: Phase angle of vout/vs at 400 MHz

equation.explanation: Phase shift from inverting low-frequency gain (180 deg) minus phase contributions from the two LHP poles and the RHP zero.

sky130_expected.calculation: phase = 180 - arctan(400/58.3) - arctan(400/331) - arctan(0.4/11.9) = 180 - 81.7 - 50.4 - 1.9 = 46.0 degrees (or -314 degrees). Text notes 50 degrees (-310 degrees).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The two poles provide ~132 degrees of phase lag, while the inverting gain provides 180 degrees, resulting in a net leading angle ~50 degrees.

dc_output_voltage.description: DC bias voltage at output node Vout

equation.explanation: Output is held at one PMOS diode drop below VDD at the bias current Id = 20 uA.

sky130_expected.calculation: For VDD = 1.8V, |Vthp| = 0.42V, Vovp ~ 0.2V: VSG2 ~ 0.62V to 0.75V, hence Vout,DC = 1.8 - 0.7 = 1.1 V to 1.35 V (scaled for 1.8V VDD).
sky130_expected.reasoning: In Baker's 5V process, Vout,DC was 3.84 V (VDD - 1.16 V); on 1.8V SKY130 it settles at VDD - VSG ~ 1.2 V.

quiescent_current.description: Amplifier stage DC quiescent current (Id of M1 and M2)

equation.explanation: Nominal operating bias current established by the bias network via Vbias4.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bias generator SUB_1 is configured to mirror nominal 20 uA branch current into M1 via Vbias4.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed for 20 uA branch current across process variations.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench for Baker Fig. 21.8 / Ex. 21.2: measures DC operating point, quiescent current, low-frequency AC gain, input pole (fin), output pole (fout), RHP zero (fz), and gain & phase at 400 MHz.
